name: Jacobi Eigendecomposition for 3x3 Symmetric Matrices
aliases: Hessian Eigenvalue Computation via Jacobi's Method
definition: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a 3x3 symmetric matrix using the Jacobi iterative diagonalization method.
summary: Jacobi eigendecomposition is an iterative method that computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a 3x3 symmetric matrix using plane rotations, preferred for its robustness over explicit cubic solutions.
